what: A ticker rename map for the S&P 500 membership walk (constituents/__init__.py, completion task 3.8): old ticker, new ticker, the first session under the new ticker, the company, and the notice that states it. Each date was read from the cited notice on 2026-11-20 (web search of the issuer's, the exchange's or the SEC's own pages); 'verified' says what each notice states.
scope: Renames of S&P 500 members whose addition the changes table records under the OLD ticker (the rows the walk could not place without a map). A rename whose addition the table already records under the new ticker needs no row and must not have one (the walk would then look for the old ticker's addition).
left_out: WLP to ANTM (2014) and ANTM to ELV (2022): the 2014 date could not be confirmed from a notice in the time available; both fall before the change table's coverage start for the addition (WLP added 1999), so membership inside coverage is the same without them. 21st Century Fox (FOX, FOXA): not a rename; Fox Corp took both tickers on 2019-03-19 and the table records the additions without 21st Century Fox's removal.
